# noVNC (vendored)

Copied from OpenHands-extensions/PA-manager `app/static/vendor/novnc`, which is
upstream noVNC. License: MPL 2.0 — see `LICENSE.txt`.

Purpose: the BMC's KVM socket speaks RFB; noVNC implements the protocol
(encodings, clipboard, input). Only `core/` and `vendor/` are used; the demo
application, tests and documentation were not copied.

Upgrade by replacing this directory wholesale from an upstream noVNC release.
Do not hand-edit these files.
